description.en: A large public university in Szeged, southern Hungary. This card lists two programmes of the Faculty of Economics and Business Administration for international students; more programmes exist and are not collected yet.
description.ru: Крупный государственный университет в Сегеде, на юге Венгрии. В карточке две программы экономического факультета для иностранных студентов; остальные программы пока не собраны.

requirements.entrance_exams: Entrance examination (fee EUR 200, non-refundable, paid by bank transfer before the exam)
Entrance examination (fee EUR 200, non-refundable, paid by bank transfer before the exam)

notes_for_reviewer: Two official pages of the Faculty of Economics and Business Administration read 2026-10-25: both state 'Tuition fee for academic year 2026/2027' for non-EU citizens, EUR 2,700 per semester (BSc Business Administration and Management) and EUR 3,000 per semester (MSc International Economy and Business); entrance examination fee EUR 200 (non-EU) on both. The pages do not state the language, the duration, deadlines or an application fee; English is assumed because they are pages 'for international students' and the university lists these as English-taught programmes (confirm). Other programmes of the university (MA English Studies EUR 2,200 per semester, MA Educational Sciences, PhD programmes) were found only on pages without a clear 2026/2027 year and are NOT collected; the university also publishes a table 'Tuition & Fees of International Programmes' for 2025, which is not used because it is for another year. The documents list is a standard guess.
